title: Streets
description: A line layer that represents streets in the City of Miami and inmediate vicinity.  Data is maintained by the City of Miami GIS Team, with the assistance of the Public Works Department and other departments that contribute information about the streets within the City.
snippet: For mapping, addresing, permitting, public safety, emegency response and other internal operations conducted by City departments.
